lm.caption: An energetic and driving Russian rock track kicks off with a powerful vocal exclamation before launching into a full-band arrangement. The sound is defined by crunchy, distorted electric guitars playing a catchy, melodic riff over a solid, propulsive bassline and a straightforward, powerful acoustic drum beat. A clear, passionate male lead vocal delivers the lyrics with force and conviction, carrying the song's high-energy, anthemic quality.
